— http://nitter.meowing.monster/teslascope/status/2102580882984915418#m

New quarter is almost here, so new features inbound for our web and mobile apps over the next few months:

⏰ Idle and Battery Drain Tracking

You'll finally be able to view a breakdown of what happened while your vehicle was idle (parked) such as sentry, cabin overheat protection, and more. One of the most requested features.

🔋 Battery Health Comparisons

This quarter we launched our battery health breakdown and recently updated it with improved metrics and visuals. Next quarter you'll be able to compare your vehicle to the fleet.

📷 Sentry Alerts (awaiting Apple review)

Receive a notification any time Sentry Model is triggered on your vehicle. We've already completed the backend work for this, and it is awaiting Apple's App Store Review. 

🎶 Media Tracking (Opt-in)

View your vehicle’s listening history during drives or while charging.

📆 Massive Calendar Rework

New weekly and monthly breakdowns, which includes comparisons to prior periods and service alerts (if subscribed to Pro).

🏆 Weekly Leaderboards
Our leaderboards will now include weekly views in addition to our lifetime ones.

More information will be shared when these features are live, and as always, we appreciate your feedback!

Tesla is releasing a new feature called Emergency Drive Away, which will allow you to drive away in case of emergency, such as life threatening situations.

Tesla noted that this can result in damage to both your vehicle and the Supercharger.


Tesla Charging (@TeslaCharging)

Emergency Drive Away lets you shift into Drive while still plugged into a Supercharger

Video
  





— http://nitter.meowing.monster/TeslaCharging/status/2105793365027819830#m

Heads up! Costs can reach $25,000 in some instances, and $500+ in vehicle repair costs alone.

Do NOT utilize this unless your life is absolutely in danger and you are unable to safely exit your vehicle to unplug the charger.


Tesla Charging (@TeslaCharging)

Depends on the Supercharger, but electrical & civil cost can be up to $25k. Service visit mandatory for the chargeport. Only use in case of an emergency.

Platform Update:

You can now set "Driver Seat Occupied" and "Driver Seat Unoccupied" as a trigger in automations.

You can also now Pause and Play Media via Schedules and as a standalone control via our Developer APIs.

Available on web now, and in the next iOS/Android update.
